text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
—The Grand Mile. Before I knew it, I had 
gathered up every victory in sight and was 
hailed as the "Mile King"...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
A Junior-tier Mile GⅠ, Oka Sho, NHK Mile 
C, Mile CS, February S, Victoria M, and 
Yasuda Kinen... That makes a whopping 
seven titles bagged!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
The "Mile King" and the "All-Rounder." 
Huh, isn't that totally breaking 
character!? ...She frets for a second, but 
only for a second.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to this grand feat, umamusume who 
rarely spoke to her before started 
striking up conversations... Everything in 
this world truly was right here!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I have become the Mile King! (Boom!) At 
this rate, I'm gonna conquer every single 
distance~~!
